maria: Bringing up HF model `openlm-xyz-chat` into Redwood. Ran the HF->Redwood converter and the samples looked totally deterministic even though the HF repo has temperature/top_p set. Anyone seen weird behavior where generation_config.json values are ignored? :thinking_face:

ajay: Can you paste the generation_config.json snippet you saw?

maria: Sure — here's the file in the HF repo:```
{
  "do_sample": false,
  "temperature": 0.7,
  "top_p": 0.9,
  "top_k": 40,
  "repetition_penalty": 1.05
}
```

natalie: Ah — `do_sample: false` usually forces greedy decoding. HF includes temp/top_p but they have no effect unless `do_sample: true` (or sampling decoding is used). Also check the chat templates and special tokens: some repos use `<|system|>` vs `<s>SYSTEM</s>` and our chat template mapper can drop system tokens which can change outputs.

ajay: Agreed. Converter currently has 2 gaps we hit frequently: 1) behavioral mismatch for `do_sample` vs Redwood's default sampling semantics, 2) missing defaults for fields HF sometimes omits (like `repetition_penalty`). Quick proposal for mapping rules:```
- If generation_config.contains("do_sample") == false OR (contains num_beams and num_beams>1 and do_sample not true) -> map to Redwood decode_strategy = "greedy" and ignore temperature/top_p/top_k.
- Else (sampling path) -> map temperature/top_p/top_k directly into Redwood generation params. If field missing use defaults: temperature=1.0, top_p=1.0, top_k=50.
- If repetition_penalty present -> map directly; else default repetition_penalty=1.0.
- If num_beams > 1 -> map to beam_search with num_beams; in that case we treat sampling params as in HF (typically ignored for deterministic beams unless do_sample true).
- Special-case: if temperature <= 0 or top_p <= 0 -> treat as greedy.
```

maria: That looks sane. One subtle case: some HF repos set `do_sample: false` but also have `temperature: 0.7` because they expect `generate(..., do_sample=True)` at runtime. We should log a warning in the converter when `do_sample:false` + non-default sampling params are present.

ajay: Yes — add a converter warning: "sampling params present but do_sample=false; confirm intended runtime behavior". Also add unit tests that exercise: (a) greedy mapping, (b) sampling mapping, (c) beam+sampling interplay, (d) repetition_penalty fallback.

natalie: Another gotcha — tokenizers and special tokens. If repo uses a custom chat template with tokens like `<|system|>`, make sure the converter writes Redwood chat roles correctly. Example mapping we should add to converter:```
HF special token -> Redwood role
"<|system|>" -> "system"
"<|user|>" -> "user"
"<|assistant|>" -> "assistant"
"<s>" / "</s>" -> strip unless used as explicit delimiter
```

infra-bot: CI check: model onboarding run failed (integration tests). Failure: output mismatch for deterministic sample tests (expected deterministic -> got sampling). See CI run: https://ci.internal/redwood/1234

maria: I ran local reproduce: converter produced model manifest with `sampling: false` but runtime still used sampling defaults because the manifest left `temperature` present and our runtime assumed sampling if temperature != 1.0. So two-fold fix: converter must remove sampling params from manifest for greedy models OR set them to explicit neutral defaults (temperature=1.0, top_p=1.0, top_k=0).

ajay: Implementation detail for the manifest format: prefer explicit fields over implicit assumptions. E.g. include "decode_strategy":"greedy" plus explicit sampling_params: `{ "temperature": 1.0, "top_p": 1.0, "top_k": 0 }` so runtime has no ambiguity.

docs-bot: Please open a short PR to docs + converter with mapping table + examples. Tag @eng-runtime and @eng-ml. Suggest PR template: converter: add tests + warning log; docs: small section "HF generation_config.json -> Redwood manifest" with mapping table and examples.

maria: I'll open a PR after lunch. Action items:```
- maria: PR with converter code + unit tests + sample HF repo (local repro)
- ajay: review and add runtime defensive logic if manifest ambiguous
- natalie: add chat-template special-token mapping doc section
- docs-bot: create docs checklist + PR template
```

ajay: One last note — repetition_penalty > 1 changes sampling behavior significantly; when switching from greedy to sampling during rollout we should run the eval suite (bleu/qa/regression tests) since quality can degrade if these params flip. Recommend a small benchmark job automatically run on PR.

maria: Agree. I'll wire the onboarding CI to run the eval harness (regression + n-lingual question tests) for any converter change that touches mapping logic.

infra-bot: Note: scheduled rollout hold until converter PR merged and CI green.

maria: thanks all :thumbsup:
